title: UniMind: Calibration-Aware Scheduling and Placement for Quantum-Accelerated AI Middleware — Code, Calibration Snapshots, QPU Job Logs and Analysis Scripts
description: Measurement study on a 156-qubit superconducting device (ibm_marrakesh) plus 34 hourly calibration snapshots (marrakesh/kingston/fez). Includes D0-D2 daily snapshots, hourly telemetry (2026-09-01 to 09-02), E2E angle batches (frozen+refresh, n=30/arm), J(G) real-label suite (k=9-18), all analysis scripts and processed results (drift_analysis, refresh_policy_analysis with 144 threshold combos, power_analysis with Wilson/Fisher/MDE, jg_feature_ablation, workload_connectivity_drift, ranking_margin_analysis). Every table is traceable to a QPU job ID (daadeocjbipc73ffq83g, daadeosjbipc73ffq840, daadgmmrbfbs73cijmbg) or calibration JSON. Code is MIT, data is CC-BY-4.0.
notes: If you use calibration_total JSON or E2E batches, please cite the TC paper (IEEE Transactions on Computers, submitted) and the Zenodo DOI. Name-disambiguation: not the Brain-Computer Interface UniMind.
